evidence.reason: At the current tip the evidence loop only checks `line > lines.length`; it does not reject `line < 1` or non-integers. Thus `line: 0`, negative values, or non-integer values can pass for an existing blob. For an empty blob, `lines` is `[]`, so `0 > 0` is false even though the preceding comment says an empty blob has no line to cite. The gate therefore accepts invalid evidence contrary to its stated purpose.
